title: `close-cards.mjs`: close a card that carries no pm-state label, and resume a half-written close — five maintainer-approved closes this summon needed a hand (#4606, #19334 done by hand; #9180, #11592, #15210 owed)
body:
立卡门 ③ — 维护者直派。原话(director-seat chat, 2026-09-24):「车队唯一的关单工具 close-cards.mjs 按设计只收带恰好一个 pm:* 状态标签的卡。 这个派卡处理。」

Filed by the director seat (summon #28 续, `session_01GLdRPcbaCBQCTvVmU6YEUY`) under that word. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the tool refuses today (`origin/main` `9a0c0b5`)

- `skipReason` in `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs`: `states.length === 0` ⇒ 「carries no pm-state label, and this run acts only on `<expect-state>`」. `--expect-state` validates against `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`; there is no spelling for "none".
- `packCard` demands exactly `PACK_ORDER` = comment → labels_remove → issue_patch; a card with nothing to strip cannot pack at all.
- Two live specimens, both approved for closure by the maintainer in the spec-card closure review (director seat, 2026-09-24):
  1. **#4606** — a legacy `status:parked` record card that never carried a pm-state (closure review batch 2, 「其他同意」, `not_planned`). The fleet's tool skips it; a one-action `issue_patch` relay script the seat wrote was refused by the container's permission classifier — correctly, the closure tool is the sanctioned path. Closing comment drafted, ⛔ unposted.
  2. **#19334** — a close that half-landed under the pre-#19824 three-write tool (the seat's checkout was stale): closing comment 5807380767 posted, `pm:queue` stripped, then the `issue_patch` refused by write-pace (write 41 of 40 in the trailing hour, exit 10). Now open and stateless (`duplicate` of #19333); re-running the tool skips it, and re-posting the comment would duplicate it.

## The ask (shape — ⛔ not a mechanism ruling; the skills seat decides the spelling)

1. **A stateless close**: `--expect-state none` (or an explicit `--stateless` flag) acts on a card carrying **zero** pm-state labels, packing comment → issue_patch (two actions; `PACK_ORDER` admits this shape only under that flag). Under that flag a card carrying any pm-state is still skipped; the existing exactly-one rule stands for every other run.
2. **A resume**: when the thread already carries this run's closing comment (same body — the `pickRelayComment` reading) and the pm-state is already gone, the run packs **only** the `issue_patch` and says so on the record — ⛔ never a second closing comment.
3. Read-back per the four-step, as today. Self-test rows: a stateless card closes with a 2-action pack; a half-state resumes with a 1-action pack; a card with a pm-state under `none` is skipped; a card with two pm-states is skipped; an assignee still skips; a dry run prints both packs and sends nothing.
4. **First use, recorded here** — three maintainer-approved closes the current tool cannot perform: the `tracking` record cards with no pm-state that the maintainer approved closing as `completed` in closure review batch 3 (「同意」, 2026-09-24): #9180 (all four carve cards landed — #10077, #10078, objectui#5356, cloud#1430), #11592 (objectui implemented ruling B, changeset `6252-page-header-action-ids`), #15210 (executions #15229 / #15232 landed). The seat that lands this closes all three with the new tool, citing this card, and says so on each. (#4606 and #19334, the two specimens above, were closed by the maintainer's own hand on 2026-09-24 after the seat reported the gap — the specimens stand as the measured shapes.)

## Grading (filed under the maintainer's word; triage may correct on first touch)

`domain:skills` · `tooling` · `priority:p3` (仪器为车队服务: two stuck seat actions this summon, named above — a maintainer-approved close that needs a human hand) · `pm:queue` · Tier S (`scripts/pm/**`, at-tier in-seat review) · `Clause-②: no`. The maintainer's 「这个派卡处理」 is the dispatch authorisation under NORTH-STAR rule 3.

## Dedup

Repo-scoped read of all 123 `tooling`-labelled issues (state=all) for `close-cards` / `stateless` / `no pm-state` / `expect-state`: **0** cards on this mechanism. Nearest: #19824 (closed `completed` — one write per card, the pack this card extends) · #19469 (closed `completed` — the tool's origin).

Reader: the `domain:skills` seat. Acceptance: `node scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs --dry-run --expect-state none` on #4606 prints WOULD CLOSE with a 2-action pack; on #19334 it prints WOULD CLOSE (resume) with a 1-action pack; the self-test passes.
